papers.title_zh: Atlas的新手 | Boston Dynamics

papers.cover_zh: Atlas装上新手！13自由度直接驱动，为真实工作而生
papers.abstract_zh: 这款新一代手部是Atlas的完美搭档。拥有13个自由度，这些手部采用直接驱动，专为高保真仿真而构建，以支持sim-to-real强化学习，并且从头开始设计用于灵巧的物理工作。了解我们如何为现代AI和实际工作打造机器人手部：https://bostondynamics.com/blog/robot-hands-for-modern-ai-and-real-work

papers.title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
papers.title_zh: 重建、练习、走向现实：具身智能体的引导式自我改进
papers.tldr_zh: RPG框架通过仿真练习自我改进机器人技能，成功率大幅提升。
papers.cover_zh: 不更新权重也能自我进化？机器人练习15轮成功率飙至95%！
papers.abstract_zh: 构建跨多样任务的可靠机器人能力需要大量人力来开发与维护技能、设计奖励并将感知与控制集成。我们提出“重建、练习、走向现实”（RPG）框架，无需更新模型权重即可自主改进机器人执行系统。RPG从离线数据集中识别操作能力，并在仿真中构建相关练习任务。练习过程中，RPG利用执行反馈、特权模拟器状态和可用数据集视频来诊断失败。它基于这些诊断开发新的可复用符号技能、优化现有技能并修订系统提示。跨任务评估测试单个候选变更和合并修订，并在保留复用前进行验证。测试时，多模态LLM使用生成的系统提示和技能库来协调感知与机器人控制。在22个操作任务的保留初始化上，RPG将任务成功率从第一轮练习后的28.6%提升至15轮后的95.0%，优于所有评估基线，包括ASPIRE（75.5%）和由GPT-6 Astra Pro驱动的CaP-Agent0（60.0%）。经过通用的校准和硬件适配流程后，冻结系统在全部30次物理试验中成功，三个任务各十次。项目网站：https://rpg-robot.github.io/

papers.title: UniWAM: Unified World-Action Model
papers.title_zh: UniWAM：统一世界-动作模型
papers.tldr_zh: UniWAM统一世界生成与动作预测，实现SOTA性能并揭示协同训练缩放定律。
papers.cover_zh: 世界模型+动作预测合体！UniWAM竟还发现缩放定律
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型受益于预训练视觉-语言模型的理解与推理能力，但仅动作监督对世界动态的接地有限。相反，世界-动作模型继承了视频生成模型的时空先验，但在分布偏移下的语义理解与推理仍然受限。我们提出 UniWAM，一种统一架构，集成了物理推理器、世界生成器和动作预测器，联合学习物理世界的语义理解、视觉生成和动作预测。为确保训练数据质量，我们为人类自我中心数据和机器人数据开发了严格的数据清洗与标注流程。为使视觉-语言组件适应具身任务同时保留其继承的语言能力，我们用自然语言表示低级动作，并引入预训练方案，将来自视觉问答（VQA）数据、人类自我中心数据和机器人演示的互补监督分配给相应的模型组件。在后训练阶段，未来视觉噪声增强减少了对精确未来预测的依赖，而历史条件流匹配使用编码的动作历史来初始化动作生成。这些设计共同显著减少了去噪步骤，同时保持性能。UniWAM 在多项评估中达到最先进（SOTA）性能，包括分布内性能、鲁棒性、泛化性、指令遵循和长时程任务执行。此外，我们揭示了统一人-机器人协同训练的对数线性缩放定律，证明了在人类和机器人数据混合上进行大规模预训练的有效性。

papers.title: Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models
papers.title_zh: Latent-Foresight：面向潜在世界模型的端到端可预测表示学习
papers.tldr_zh: 端到端联合学习潜在表示与动力学模型，提升未来场景预测。
papers.cover_zh: 两阶段训练终于能扔了｜这个端到端框架让潜在世界模型更懂预测
papers.abstract_zh: 预测场景的未来演化是世界建模的一项基本能力。近期工作表明，在视觉基础模型（VFM）的特征空间中操作能产生语义丰富的表示，支持多样化的未来场景理解任务。然而，现有方法依赖两阶段流程：先使用固定降维（如PCA）或独立训练的自编码器压缩VFM特征，再在得到的冻结潜在空间上训练单独的预测器。这种表示学习与时间预测的解耦，以及直接在原始VFM特征上应用预测器的方法，都无法保证潜在空间的结构适合可预测的动态。在本工作中，我们提出Latent-Foresight，一个端到端框架，联合学习潜在分词器和基于流的生成动力学模型，显式地塑造表示以支持时间可预测性。为实现稳定的联合优化，我们引入了若干关键设计选择，防止潜在坍缩并使重建与生成目标对齐。大量实验表明，我们的方法学习到时间上更连贯的潜在表示，并在多个未来场景理解任务和预测时间范围上持续优于两阶段基线，同时消除了单独的训练阶段，包括在高分辨率适应期间。我们提供了实现代码和模型权重，见 https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight。

papers.title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
papers.title_zh: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
papers.tldr_zh: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising ye
papers.cover_zh: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising ye
papers.abstract_zh: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.

papers.title: ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
papers.title_zh: ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
papers.tldr_zh: Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effecto
papers.cover_zh: Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effecto
papers.abstract_zh: Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effector tracking while the base keeps walking. Combining reinforcement learning (RL) with model predictive control (MPC) suits this task: the learned policy provides robust locomotion, while MPC coordinates the base and arm to compensate for tracking errors. However, MPC can compensate only for base motion that it can predict, and a learned policy's command response varies with gait phase, contact, and payload. We present ReCo, a framework that couples response-consistent locomotion with policy-aware MPC for legged manipulation. Response shaping trains the policy to respond to commands consistently and repeatably across randomized dynamics. An identified closed-loop response model then lets MPC jointly plan locomotion commands and arm motion. On the simulation benchmark, ReCo reduces position and orientation root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 28.7% and 27.4% relative to the best baseline for each metric. Real-world experiments demonstrate onboard continuous legged manipulation with coordinated base and arm motion.

papers.title: ActiveWAM: Evidence-Aware Active Vision for World-Action Models
papers.title_zh: ActiveWAM: Evidence-Aware Active Vision for World-Action Models
papers.tldr_zh: Active vision manipulation requires a policy to control both
papers.cover_zh: Active vision manipulation requires a policy to control both
papers.abstract_zh: Active vision manipulation requires a policy to control both its camera and its end-effectors, yet camera motion determines which evidence remains visible within finite observation windows. Acquiring a new view can displace task-critical cues, while retaining a view forgoes potentially useful observations. We formulate this as an evidence-aware retain--acquire problem and present ActiveWAM, a unified world--action model that learns observation and manipulation jointly. To this end, we propose training-time inversion which constrains a frozen video prior by task-bearing source evidence and visible temporal changes, eliminating the need for test-time inversion or candidate ranking. At deployment, the policy generates bimanual and pan/tilt actions-including stay and reacquisition behaviors-from view-aware history, and updates context from newly measured RGB observations. Future-video prediction serves as a co-training signal, while action generation requires neither future-video decoding nor optimal viewpoint annotations. We introduce RoboTwin-AV, a 50-task benchmark with executable pan/tilt control and automatically generated demonstrations. ActiveWAM improves TAVIS out-of-distribution success by up to 17.0 percentage points over the strongest baselines, achieves 20.0 additional points over Fast-WAM on RoboTwin-AV, and outperforms it by 26.7 points on real-world physical kitchen tasks.

papers.title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
papers.title_zh: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
papers.tldr_zh: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of
papers.cover_zh: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of
papers.abstract_zh: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of dexterous robot manipulation data, but transferring them across embodiments requires physically feasible retargeting. Existing physics-based approaches face limitations in retargeting success, motion-specific training efficiency, or both. To address these limitations, we introduce FlashDexRetarget, an RL-based framework for high-success, efficient dexterous motion retargeting. To make the demonstrated interaction easier to learn, we combine object point-cloud observations, hand-object distance features, and future trajectory encodings with complementary rewards that supervise object motion and reference hand-object relationships. To further accelerate learning, we employ separate left- and right-hand actor critic networks and adapt the off-policy algorithm, FlashSAC to dexterous motion tracking. On a benchmark of 50 motions spanning single-object and two-object interactions, FlashDexRetarget achieves a 90% success rate, approximately 2.5x that of the evaluated sampling-based baselines, while requiring up to 100x less training compute than the evaluated RL-based baselines. Evaluations on both XHand and Sharpa Wave Hand show consistent gains, and component-wise ablations examine the contributions of our design choices. Beyond the 50-motion benchmark, experiments with 200, 500, and 1,000 motions demonstrate that our method remains stable at larger scales and produces successful retargeted motions more efficiently as the training set grows. Qualitative replay results using real-world-captured demonstrations further illustrate the applicability of our framework to recorded human manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/

papers.title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
papers.title_zh: HumanoidToolBench：从选择到移动执行的人形机器人工具使用基准测试
papers.tldr_zh: 人形机器人工具使用新基准，揭示选工具与完成任务间的显著差距。
papers.cover_zh: 人形机器人选对工具却完不成任务？这个基准测出了真实差距
papers.abstract_zh: 随着机器人硬件和学习方法的进步，人形机器人需要借助工具来完成超出其固有物理极限的任务。成功的工具使用需要选择合适的工具，并协调操作以及必要时的移动来完成整个任务。现有基准测试并未在人形机器人上联合评估这些能力。我们提出了 HumanoidToolBench，一个包含 18 个任务的基准测试，涵盖三种场景、三个执行层级和两种工具集模式，并配套 ToolBook 数据集，其中包含在仿真环境和真实 Unitree G1 机器人上采集的 3.1k 条演示数据。在仿真环境中对七种策略、在真实机器人上对三种策略的评估揭示了从选择合适的工具到完成任务之间存在显著差距。针对 GR00T N1.7 的专项探测实验表明，在面对未见过的工具时选择准确率下降，并且在无关指令下仍会继续执行任务。代码和数据可在 https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/ 获取。

papers.title: DuoMind: Enabling Distributed Multi-Robot Coordination with Semantic Communication
papers.title_zh: DuoMind：通过语义通信实现分布式多机器人协调
papers.tldr_zh: DuoMind 框架通过语义通信实现分布式多机器人协调，提升任务性能。
papers.cover_zh: 多机器人协调新突破｜语义通信让 VLM 和 VLA 强强联手
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉语言动作模型（VLA）最近推动了通用机器人的快速进展，但大多数进展集中在单机器人场景。将这些能力扩展到多机器人系统仍然具有挑战性，因为机器人必须在保持可靠、细粒度执行的同时协调长期行为。我们引入了 DuoMind，一个通过语义通信实现多机器人协调的分布式分层框架。每个机器人使用基于 VLA 的动作模型进行低级执行，并使用基于 VLM 的协调器进行高级推理和智能体间协调。在每个规划步骤，每个机器人的协调器对任务指令、局部观察和从其他机器人接收的消息进行推理。然后，它为动作模型生成低级指令，并为同伴机器人生成语义消息。该架构通过结合 VLM 的语义推理能力和 VLA 的精确动作生成能力，利用了预训练模型的互补优势。为了解决多机器人协调基准的稀缺性，我们进一步开发了 RoboPoly，一个包含长期操作任务的基准，需要在分布式控制下进行协调的闭环执行。在 RoboPoly 和 RoboTwin 上的实验表明，DuoMind 提高了多机器人任务性能，消融研究证实了分层协调和语义通信的贡献。更多细节可在我们的项目页面上找到。

papers.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.title_zh: InterEvolve：人形机器人移动操作奖励程序的测试时进化
papers.tldr_zh: InterEvolve 在测试时进化奖励程序，释放人形机器人移动操作潜能。
papers.cover_zh: 人类奖励没发掘的潜力，LLM进化程序竟让机器人自己学会新技能
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究人形机器人移动操作的测试时进化：通过重用现有技能、从自身尝试中改进并保留所学，无需重新训练即可解决控制器从未训练过的任务。我们的关键见解是，一个广泛的控制器已经具备新任务所需的大部分能力，而这种能力可以通过规划与控制之间的接口来获取，该接口足够表达以指定接触丰富的多阶段交互，又足够可执行和可度量，使得执行反馈能够从经验中指导规划。InterEvolve 用两个组件实现这一接口。首先，我们开发了一个对象感知的前向-后向（FB）行为基础模型，其在冻结身体先验上的对象残差在测试时将关于身体或对象的新奖励转化为移动操作行为。其次，我们将任务指定为奖励程序：带有完成条件和可调常数的分阶段奖励。一个大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在上下文中根据执行反馈和已验证程序的技能库修改程序结构，而数值优化器调整其常数。每个候选程序在并行仿真场景中验证，程序探索新方式以诱导、重用和组合控制器现有的运动能力来完成当前任务，从而在迭代中改进。实验表明，人类设计的奖励未能充分利用 FB 模型的移动操作能力，而 InterEvolve 进化的程序释放了这些能力，有时通过新颖策略。它进一步在仿真中为多样任务、复杂场景和长时程组合生成行为，并且进化的技能从自我中心机载感知在物理 Unitree G1 上自主运行。

papers.title: ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection
papers.title_zh: ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection
papers.tldr_zh: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improv
papers.cover_zh: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improv
papers.abstract_zh: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

papers.title: SkeleWAM: Skeleton World-Action Modeling for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
papers.title_zh: SkeleWAM：用于高效机器人操作的骨架世界-动作建模
papers.tldr_zh: SkeleWAM用稀疏3D骨架统一表示场景，实现高效机器人操作。
papers.cover_zh: 抛弃视频预测！这个模型用稀疏骨架让机器人操作更高效
papers.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将机器人动作生成与未来状态预测相结合。现有的WAMs通常预测视频或学习到的视觉潜在表示，这些表示仅隐式地表示交互几何，并可能保留与控制无关的外观信息。我们提出了SkeleWAM，一种紧凑的WAM，将操作场景表示为由机器人关节、物体中心和交互点组成的稀疏3D骨架。该骨架从当前的RGB-D观测和机器人本体感知在线构建，为动作生成和未来骨架预测提供了统一的几何状态。未来骨架预测为动作学习提供了额外的几何监督，而无需视觉重建。在推理时，SkeleWAM直接从当前骨架和语言指令生成动作，而Medoid Action Consensus（MAC）作为一种辅助共识策略用于随机动作样本。在LIBERO-Plus上，SkeleWAM以57.1M参数实现了85.9%的整体成功率，比Cosmos-Policy高出3.7个百分点。这些结果表明，稀疏的3D机器人-物体结构为稳健且参数高效的世界动作学习提供了有效的状态空间。项目见 https://skelewam-project.github.io/。

papers.title: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
papers.title_zh: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
papers.tldr_zh: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on languag
papers.cover_zh: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on languag
papers.abstract_zh: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.

papers.title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
papers.title_zh: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
papers.tldr_zh: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting object
papers.cover_zh: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting object
papers.abstract_zh: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy. Across 100 sampled preferences in simulation, 67 behaviors are non-dominated under exact Pareto dominance, with a mean preference-objective correlation of 0.843, demonstrating broad Pareto coverage and predictable preference response. The same policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree Go2, where preference changes alone reduce specific energy by up to 30.4%, position error by 38.7%, and peak body-attitude deviation by 59.0% relative to the balanced preference. These results establish preference-conditioned multi-objective RL as a practical runtime interface for adaptive legged locomotion, extending its role beyond offline Pareto-set construction. Open-source code and videos are available at https://amrmousa.com/promo/.

papers.title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
papers.title_zh: 更少Token，更优动作：GPT-6 Astra机器人智能体成功率提升14%但Token减少65%
papers.tldr_zh: PyRUA-Lean框架提升机器人任务成功率并大幅减少Token消耗。
papers.cover_zh: Token少用65%｜成功率反升14%！机器人智能体新框架
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体可以通过视觉反馈和动作原语控制机器人，但重复的模型调用和冗余观察会带来大量Token开销。我们提出PyRUA-Lean，一种交互式代码执行框架，将反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观察相结合：智能体将经典机器人原语和学到的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略组合成Python单元，执行条件检查和局部重试，仅返回明确请求的图像和状态反馈用于重新规划。在来自LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0和RoboCasa365的700个模拟任务实例上，我们将PyRUA-Lean与使用相同GPT-6 Astra规划器和底层机器人原语的工具调用基线进行比较。在相同的LLM调用预算下，PyRUA-Lean将总体成功率从63.1%提高到71.7%。在两者均解决的实例上，它使用的LLM调用减少49%，输入Token减少65%。

papers.title: World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling
papers.title_zh: 世界观察者：联合演员-观察者生成实现持久世界建模
papers.tldr_zh: 解耦观察与行动，联合生成演员和全景观察者，持续建模视野外动态。
papers.cover_zh: 视野外物体消失就失忆？新方法让世界模型持续观察
papers.abstract_zh: 世界模型如何持续观察演员当前视野之外的区域？视频世界模型模拟环境如何随智能体动作演化，但仍以演员为中心。一旦物体离开演员视野，它们就失去了其演化的直接证据，往往在重新进入时无法保持其状态和动态。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 World Observer，它通过联合生成一个以智能体为中心的视角演员与一个或多个观察选定世界区域的全景观察者，将观察与行动解耦。这使得离开演员视野的物体在观察者中保持视觉演化，从而在重新进入时反映其更新状态。我们通过从共享全景源进行变形来为演员和观察者提供显式几何对应，并引入高分辨率透视参考的 Observer Sink 以在重新进入时恢复精细外观。由于观察者与演员解耦，它们可以自由放置在场景中，扩展到多个位置以扩大覆盖范围，并由控制信号驱动以引导视野外的演化。为了评估视野外演化，我们进一步引入了世界空间指标和涵盖真实与合成场景的基准。World Observer 显著改善了视野外动态，同时在视觉保真度、相机控制和 3D  adherence 方面保持竞争力。

papers.title: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
papers.title_zh: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
papers.tldr_zh: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot
papers.cover_zh: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot
papers.abstract_zh: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.

papers.title: Learning a Resolution-Consistent Jacobian Field for Bio-Inspired Rigid-Soft Finger
papers.title_zh: Learning a Resolution-Consistent Jacobian Field for Bio-Inspired Rigid-Soft Finger
papers.tldr_zh: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fing
papers.cover_zh: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fing
papers.abstract_zh: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fingers exhibit strong nonlinearity and configuration-dependent sensitivity, making accurate modeling challenging. In discrete-time control, Jacobian-based kinematic algorithms typically rely on point-wise local linear approximations, which makes their performance sensitive to sensor sampling frequency and controller update frequency. To address this issue, we propose Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a structured learning framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM), to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field that models actuation-to-motion transitions as a dynamical flow. The proposed framework supports both single-step prediction and continuous rollout via ODE integration, enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions. Experiments on a tendon-driven rigid-soft finger show that the proposed method suppresses outlier errors and improves single-step prediction accuracy, reducing the global average RMSE by over 53% compared with a baseline discrete Jacobian learning approach. For long-horizon prediction, trajectories recovered via ODE integration achieve higher fidelity under sparse sampling (Stride = 8), reducing the RMSE median by 14.43% and the error variance by 24.87%. These results demonstrate that the learned flow-based Jacobian field provides an effective local model for offline multi-step trajectory optimization in rigid-soft coupled nonlinear systems.

papers.title: Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image
papers.title_zh: Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image
papers.tldr_zh: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of arti
papers.cover_zh: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of arti
papers.abstract_zh: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of articulated objects unlocks a wide range of capabilities for interaction and manipulation. The estimation has to happen from the information the robot currently observes, often just a single RGB image of an object it has never seen before. Current single-image approaches couple articulation part segmentation with articulation estimation, making their predictions vulnerable to missed detections and incorrect part associations, and they regress metric 3D geometry that a single view fixes only up to scale. We present QueryArt, a model that estimates articulation parameters from a single RGB image, a 2D query point, and camera intrinsics. QueryArt is trained to estimate the 3D articulation geometry relative to the queried point and in units of its depth, which keeps its target identifiable from the image alone. A single depth measurement at the query point then supplies the scale and recovers the metric parameters. We train QueryArt on a curated mixture of synthetic and real-world articulation datasets. We evaluate QueryArt on several benchmarks and compare it against recent baselines. QueryArt outperforms recent baselines on most articulation metrics, including on out-of-distribution data. To demonstrate the model's capabilities in real-world settings, we evaluate QueryArt on a mobile manipulator across 57 manipulation trials spanning 16 object parts and five viewpoint classes, achieving a 70.2% success rate. We provide code and videos at: https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/

papers.title: 3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability
papers.title_zh: 3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability
papers.tldr_zh: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observati
papers.cover_zh: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observati
papers.abstract_zh: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world. To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision. However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable. We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace. Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics. Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID

papers.title: GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking
papers.title_zh: GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking
papers.tldr_zh: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of gen
papers.cover_zh: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of gen
papers.abstract_zh: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.

papers.title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: LiteReality-Agent：用于可交互3D室内场景重建的智能体系统
papers.tldr_zh: 智能体将3D重建转为编码问题，生成可仿真数字孪生。
papers.cover_zh: 把3D重建变成写代码？这个智能体让数字孪生直接可仿真
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出 LiteReality-Agent，一个智能体系统，用于从 RGB-D 扫描中重建真实室内环境，生成逼真、可铰接且可直接用于仿真的 3D 场景。其核心是将 3D 重建表述为一个编码问题：编码智能体使用专用工具收集证据，并迭代编辑一个 Python 脚本 Room.py，执行该脚本即可生成房间的 3D 数字孪生。基于这一表述，我们开发了一个鲁棒的“观察-编辑-验证”框架，在整个重建过程中支持证据收集、测量、验证、布局优化、仿真就绪和质量控制。LiteReality-Agent 生成高质量的重建结果，适用于仿真和下游具身 AI 任务。此外，随着智能体能力持续快速提升，LiteReality-Agent 所引入的系统仍是一个强大的未来智能体编排框架：它为其配备专用工具、结构化工作流和鲁棒的验证机制，显著提升重建质量和可靠性。我们证明，LiteReality-Agent 生成的重建结果在几何精度、视觉逼真度和仿真兼容性上均优于近期前沿模型（如 Astra 和 Fable）所生成的结果。因此，我们将 LiteReality-Agent 视为鲁棒 real-to-sim 系统的一个实用且重要的构建模块。源代码和数据采集应用均已公开。代码：https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/

papers.title: Awomo-SimDataEngine: Agentic Simulation-ReadyWorld Generation
papers.title_zh: Awomo-SimDataEngine：面向仿真就绪世界的智能体化生成系统
papers.tldr_zh: 智能体系统生成仿真就绪场景与演示，提升跨模拟器策略训练成功率。
papers.cover_zh: 机器人训练数据不够用？这个系统让仿真场景自动生成，成功率飙升！
papers.abstract_zh: 生成有用的机器人训练数据需要的不仅仅是视觉上逼真的场景：物体必须支持交互，布局必须保持物理有效性，任务必须能够重复执行。我们提出 Awomo-SimDataEngine，一个将资产和场景生成与机器人演示合成连接起来的智能体系统。共享资产服务提供刚性和铰接物体，包括基于结构接地的部件和关节生成（使用 ISArt）。场景生成支持两种互补路径：Unravel 从图像重建可编辑场景，而 SimForge 从文本构建单房间和多房间环境。一个图原生执行框架协调构建、验证和有界修复，将失败路由到负责模块，同时保留未受影响的场景状态。PolicyForge 将验证过的世界与任务和机器人实体绑定，以生成可重放的演示。评估涵盖资产几何、场景质量和下游策略学习。在基于 MuJoCo 的 LIBERO-Plus 上，与 Isaac Sim 演示联合训练将 World-Action Model (WAM) 的整体成功率从 77.17% 提升至 89.43%。目标和空间成功率分别提升了 31.66 和 6.25 个百分点。这些结果支持生成数据用于跨模拟器策略训练的效用，但在长时任务上增益较为有限。

papers.title: Network-in-the-Loop at Scale: GPU-Batched 5G Simulation for Massively Parallel Robot Learning
papers.title_zh: 大规模网络在环：面向大规模并行机器人学习的GPU批处理5G仿真
papers.tldr_zh: GPU批处理5G仿真实现百万机器人网络在环训练。
papers.cover_zh: 百万机器人同时训练？这个GPU仿真让5G网络在环不掉队
papers.abstract_zh: 大规模并行GPU模拟器在数千个环境中训练多机器人策略，许多机器人集群使用私有5G网络，其中每个机器人的延迟取决于队友的流量。网络在环训练将模拟的5G网络置于这个循环中。然而，GPU机器人模拟器将网络简化为每条消息的独立延迟，而包级模拟器每个CPU进程运行一个场景，无法跟上数千个并行环境。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Isaac-Net，一个GPU批处理的5G新空口（NR）模块，与Isaac Lab物理引擎同步推进数千个环境的上行链路。Isaac-Net一次性模拟所有环境的每个时隙（基站决定哪些机器人传输的0.5毫秒间隔）。大量实验证实，其NR引擎在不同负载下复现了ns-3 5G-LENA的中位延迟，在未见过的载波上中位延迟低5-10%，在闭环中每个环境32个机器人时高9%。该引擎还复现了信息年龄（AoI），即每个机器人最新交付报告的新鲜度，而每条消息的独立延迟使AoI尾部大约轻了三倍。在针对5G-LENA验证的配置中，Isaac-Net在随机策略下测量，在一个GPU上为约一百万个机器人保持网络在环，达到无网络时Isaac Lab速率的83%。Isaac-Net已在https://github.com/ZzZTripleZzZ/isaac-net开源。

papers.title: ChunkVLA-AM: Parallel Action Chunking for Vision-Language-Action Robot Control in Additive Manufacturing
papers.title_zh: ChunkVLA-AM: Parallel Action Chunking for Vision-Language-Action Robot Control in Additive Manufacturing
papers.tldr_zh: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception,
papers.cover_zh: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception,
papers.abstract_zh: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception, language understanding, and action generation, offering new opportunities for automation in additive manufacturing (AM). However, deployment in AM remains challenging because adapting these models to unseen robot embodiments is costly, and performance can degrade under environment changes. In this work, we present a framework for deploying OpenVLA-OFT on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in a fixed AM workcell. A data pipeline converts monocular real-world demonstrations into OpenVLA-compatible TFDS/RLDS datasets to support adaptation to the FR3 embodiment. At runtime, each inference request predicts an eight-step chunk of 7-D actions. The FR3 executes each chunk open loop before capturing a new observation, providing closed-loop feedback between chunks. The system uses a cloud-edge architecture in which the FR3 client streams observations to a remote inference server through a FastAPI interface. In 42 physical A-to-B object-transfer trials, evenly split between red and blue targets, the system succeeded in 39 (92.9%). All three failures occurred during final placement, when insufficient release-height control caused the object to topple. An illumination sweep identified a low-error luminance range of 85-125 on a 0-255 scale, with the lowest mean spatial error at 95.

papers.title: 4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry
papers.title_zh: 4Director：用刚性3D几何控制视频世界模型
papers.tldr_zh: 4Director用刚性3D几何控制视频生成，提升运动控制精度。
papers.cover_zh: 视频世界模型新突破｜用刚性3D几何精准控制物体运动
papers.abstract_zh: 精确控制相机和物体运动对于专业视频制作至关重要。现有方法只能粗略控制物体，通过图像平面线索（在深度和旋转上存在歧义）或通过缺乏完整几何且跨视角变化时失去一致性的3D轨迹和斑点。我们提出4Director，一种以显式4D场景表示为条件的视频世界模型：每个物体从输入图像中一次性重建为规范网格，并通过每帧一个规定的刚性变换进行移动。这种表示提供了直观的3D控制界面，并防止未观察到的几何在每一帧中被独立重新生成。我们将受控场景渲染为深度视频，并引入运动适配器，将该几何脚手架转换为视频，同时合成视角一致的外观、光照和非刚性动态。为了训练，我们构建了RealCOD-Rigid，一个由自动流程标注了刚性3D场景的新数据集，包含20,774个片段。我们进一步引入身份门控IoU（IG-IoU），它联合评估对规定物体运动的遵循和物体身份的保持。实验表明，4Director在视觉质量以及相机和物体控制方面始终优于先前方法。

papers.title: SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL
papers.title_zh: SPHERE：基于LLM增强空间偏好学习和人在回路强化学习的自适应VR室内场景生成
papers.tldr_zh: SPHERE框架通过LLM和人在回路RL实现自适应VR场景生成，减少用户编辑负担。
papers.cover_zh: VR场景生成还能这样？LLM+人在回路RL让创作不再累！
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）推动了3D室内场景合成的发展，但当前流程无法跨会话保留用户特定偏好，使得沉浸式创作成为重复且体力消耗大的过程。我们提出SPHERE，一种自适应VR生成框架，将孤立的合成转变为持续的人机协同创作。SPHERE从自然多模态交互（语音和控制器编辑）中提取持久空间偏好。为确保对空间畸变的几何鲁棒性，它将原始编辑抽象为分层约束，同时建模局部功能上下文和全局拓扑上下文。此外，人在回路强化学习机制根据用户最终编辑的场景动态更新检索策略。一项混合设计用户研究（N=42）和离线消融实验表明，SPHERE显著减少了纠正性编辑和体力需求，防止偏向浅层物体级特征，从而生成几何鲁棒、与用户画像对齐的布局。最终，SPHERE展示了如何通过捕捉演示的空间逻辑实现受控的空间适应，为沉浸式创作建立可靠、可治理的人机协作框架。项目页面和源代码将在https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE提供。

papers.title: ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
papers.title_zh: ROWBench：视频模型能渲染出程序所指定的内容吗？
papers.tldr_zh: 新基准 PROWBench 评估视频模型对程序指定事件的视觉保真度。
papers.cover_zh: 视频模型真的按程序渲染吗？新基准 PROWBench 来检验
papers.abstract_zh: 可编程世界模型将可执行动力学与视觉生成分离，为下一代游戏引擎提供了有前景的基础。然而，它们对显式规则和交互的视觉遵循程度尚未得到充分评估。现有基准测试评估视觉质量、可控性以及指令或物理遵循性，但很少测试对细粒度、程序指定的世界事件的保真度。我们引入了 PROWBench，包含 170 个程序化构建的片段和 600 个代理视频，覆盖多样场景和交互。PROWBench 记录实体状态和时间戳事件（包括相机视野之外的事件）作为可重放的世界记录，并从中渲染同步视图和代理表示。这使得生成的视频能够对照程序执行的可观察后果进行检查。一个可扩展框架构建场景、控制行为，并能以不同表示（如粗 3D 和边界框）渲染每个相机视图。该基准覆盖第一和第三人称视角，并为部分片段提供同步多视图观察。基于这些记录，PROWBench 评估实体控制、长时程记忆，并通过两个基于 VLM 的指标——逻辑-渲染对齐和交互成功率——评估对规定时间线的遵循以及时间戳引擎记录事件的视觉实现。

papers.title: Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
papers.title_zh: Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
papers.tldr_zh: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generaliz
papers.cover_zh: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generaliz
papers.abstract_zh: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generalization to unseen manipulation methods due to the limited ability to capture transferable forensic cues. Recent cross-reconstruction based methods attempt to improve generalization through semantic-artifact disentanglement, but typically align heterogeneous artifacts across generators and exclude artifact representations during reconstruction, which may overlook the inherent diversity and visual cues of manipulation artifacts. In this work, we revisit cross-reconstruction and introduce an artifact-oriented disentanglement framework for robust image forgery detection. We argue that textbf{artifact diversity}, i.e., the intrinsic variations of manipulation artifacts introduced by different generation processes, contains complementary forensic cues rather than undesirable domain variations. Instead of enforcing explicit artifact alignment, our framework preserves diverse artifact characteristics through semantically aligned cross-generator reconstruction. Furthermore, we incorporate artifact representations into the reconstruction process and introduce a masked frequency-aware reconstruction strategy to emphasize manipulation-related residuals while reducing semantic interference. This design enables the model to learn transferable forensic representations from diverse artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements under both cross-dataset and cross-generator evaluation settings. Further analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of artifact diversity preservation and artifact-aware cross-reconstruction.

papers.title: Do MLLM Judges Judge the Edit? Auditing Bias in Image Editing Evaluation with Verified Quality Preservation
papers.title_zh: Do MLLM Judges Judge the Edit? Auditing Bias in Image Editing Evaluation with Verified Quality Preservation
papers.tldr_zh: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly us
papers.cover_zh: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly us
papers.abstract_zh: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for instruction-based image editing and as reward signals for model training. However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality. To address this challenge, we introduce EditJudgeBias, a counterfactual benchmark with verified quality preservation, comprising 1,196 real editing samples and 13 cues injected across four evaluation sites. We verify quality preservation for the requested edit using calibrated multimodal validators, controls, and human inspection. We then audit five MLLM judges along three complementary dimensions: invariance to quality-preserving cues, agreement with human judgments, and stability of pairwise preferences. Importantly, observed shifts are evaluated against each judge's own zero-dose and re-query noise floors rather than against zero. Experiments show that quality-preserving cues move every judge beyond its own noise. Fabricated majority opinions increase ratings, irrelevant visual elements cause larger shifts than whole-image manipulations, and swapping candidate order reverses up to 60.9% of pairwise decisions. Edit-region cues also tend to reduce human agreement. The three measures characterize judges differently, showing that robustness cannot be captured by a single metric.

papers.title: GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design
papers.title_zh: GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design
papers.tldr_zh: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requ
papers.cover_zh: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requ
papers.abstract_zh: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench, a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets. Training representative localizers on GIFTBench consistently improves their aggregate transfer to external datasets, showing that the benchmark serves not only as an evaluation tool but also as an effective training resource for cross-domain localization. Guided by the diagnostic findings, we further develop ForenScope, a detection and localization framework combining classification-adapted representations with multi-depth, multi-scale spatial features, learned layer fusion, and selective coarse-scale conditioning. Experiments show improved cross-dataset localization while retaining image-level detection capability. The GIFTBench dataset showcase page is available at https://giftbench-preview.doudoudouya337.chatgpt.site.

papers.title: Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry
papers.title_zh: 潜在JEPA：面向化学潜在推理的抽象未来预测
papers.tldr_zh: 提出Latent JEPA框架，用抽象未来预测训练连续潜在思维，提升化学推理。
papers.cover_zh: 不写中间步骤也能推理？这个框架让化学直觉直接预测未来
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型为化学推理提供了有前景的基础，将化学知识与多步问题求解相结合。化学直觉能在解决方案细节完全展开之前，提供对可能结果的初步感知。受这种预期如何补充显式分析的启发，我们研究如何训练连续潜在思维来预测未来解决方案的信息性方面，而无需将每个中间步骤都言语化。我们提出Latent JEPA，一个将自回归学习与一个或多个未来视图的联合嵌入预测相结合的框架。针对化学推理，我们开发了文本和分子预测目标，将潜在思维与后续推理和分子结果联系起来。在ChemCoTBench上的实验表明，在分子优化以及若干编辑和反应指标上取得了提升。表示分析表明，未来预测使潜在思维对分子结果更具信息性，并增强了其与化学结构的对应关系。这些发现支持将抽象未来预测作为连接连续潜在推理与科学结果的学习原则。

papers.title: Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition
papers.title_zh: 面向街景天气识别的天气感知域适应
papers.tldr_zh: 提出WA-ADDA方法，提升街景天气识别在域偏移下的性能。
papers.cover_zh: 街景天气识别总翻车？这个域适应方法让模型在雨雪雾天也稳了
papers.abstract_zh: 雨、雪、雾和沙尘等恶劣条件对自动驾驶中基于摄像头的感知仍具挑战性。我们研究域偏移下基于街景图像的多类天气识别，其中大多数可用训练数据来自与真实驾驶场景显著不同的非街景来源。我们提出天气感知对抗判别域适应（WA-ADDA），它使域判别器以预测天气为条件，以促进既域不变又天气敏感的特征。我们还通过将多样化的非街景天气集合统一为源域、真实街景图像作为目标域，构建了一个多数据集基准，并定义了以宏平均准确率为主指标的标准化评估协议。在多种骨干网络（ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet）上，WA-ADDA 持续提升街景性能，在挑战性条件下获得强每类召回率，同时保持晴朗天气准确率。这些发现凸显了域适应天气识别的可行性以及我们的基准对推进鲁棒车载感知的价值。

papers.title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking
papers.title_zh: 探索生成图像水印对潜在频域掩码的脆弱性
papers.tldr_zh: 提出潜在频域掩码攻击，可移除或削弱多种扩散水印。
papers.cover_zh: 水印这么容易被抹掉？潜在频域攻击揭示新漏洞
papers.abstract_zh: 不可见水印已成为追踪AI生成图像的核心工具，但其对抗自适应移除攻击的鲁棒性仍是一个开放的安全问题。我们提出了潜在频域掩码攻击，通过替换水印图像潜在表示中的选定傅里叶系数来消除水印证据。替换系数可从高斯噪声中采样以提高效率，或从扩散再生中导出以改善图像保真度。我们提供了理论失真界，关联了重建对抗图像与掩码潜在频域扰动之间的变化。我们在DiffusionDB和MS-COCO提示生成的图像上，针对六种扩散水印方法评估了所提出的攻击。潜在频域掩码移除或显著削弱了若干水印，同时保持了感知质量，并且与现有攻击相比实现了有利的运行时间。这些结果将潜在频域操纵识别为一个实际的攻击面，并强调需要将此类攻击纳入生成图像水印的鲁棒性评估中。

papers.title: Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos
papers.title_zh: 贝尔曼遇上李雅普诺夫：通过掌握混沌的无监督强化学习
papers.tldr_zh: 提出F-CIP无监督RL目标，无需选择信息变量，能发现基本行为并产生协调步态。
papers.cover_zh: 贝尔曼遇上李雅普诺夫｜无监督RL竟能自学跳跃奔跑！
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）是训练智能体的强大范式，但其成功依赖于人类工程师的领域专业知识，他们为每个新任务设计信息丰富的奖励信号。无监督RL旨在通过内在动机（IM）减少这种工程：奖励信号从智能体与环境的交互中涌现。然而，现有的IM目标涉及信息变量的选择，这重新引入了该领域试图消除的领域专业知识。我们引入了Forward CIP（F-CIP），这是一种RL原生的可控信息生产（CIP）目标的公式化表述，它仅由系统动力学定义，无需此类选择。我们证明了F-CIP与RL兼容，并用现有算法展示了其有效性。使用F-CIP训练智能体可以无监督地发现基本行为，如平衡和保持可控性，这些行为对于更复杂的机器人行为至关重要。结合简单的前向速度奖励，我们的方法产生了协调的步态，如跳跃和奔跑，否则这些需要奖励工程来学习。

papers.title: Task-Adaptive Grounded 3D-Programmers Using 2D VLMs
papers.title_zh: 任务自适应接地3D程序员：利用2D视觉语言模型
papers.tldr_zh: 提出CCF和TAF，让2D VLM无需重训即可可靠进行3D理解与生成。
papers.cover_zh: 2D视觉语言模型直接玩转3D？｜无需重训的几何感知新框架
papers.abstract_zh: 近期视觉语言模型（VLM）展现出卓越的泛化和推理能力，然而这些模型在3D理解方面受限于数据规模、训练多样性和推理能力。我们并非简单地将这些模型扩展到3D，而是采取不同方法：通过引入3D接地和迭代反馈循环，并借助两个新概念——规范坐标框架（CCF）和任务自适应反馈（TAF），使强大的2D VLM能够在3D中可靠运行。CCF作为一种统一的视觉表示，将输入和输出锚定到共享的欧几里得坐标系，解决了3D接地中的常见挑战，如轴歧义、度量尺度不一致和浮动参考。与这种对3D输入的结构化框架互补，TAF通过任务自适应的动态反馈闭合推理循环，使2D VLM能够在其原生视觉上下文中执行各种开放词汇任务。在此基础上，我们引入了3D-Prog，一个3D理解、推理和生成框架，它结合CCF和TAF的能力与强大的VLM。无需任何重新训练，3D-Prog即可在对象级和场景级任务中执行开放词汇的3D理解、操作和生成。我们的实验表明，联合使用CCF和TAF将2D VLM转变为几何感知的3D程序员，在各种3D任务中实现一致、可解释且高质量的结果。

papers.title: Watch, Infer, Coordinate: Inferring Robot Partner Constraints for Zero-Shot Coordination
papers.title_zh: 观察、推断、协调：面向零样本协调的机器人伙伴约束推断
papers.tldr_zh: 通过观察联合行为推断机器人伙伴的物理约束，实现零样本协调。
papers.cover_zh: 机器人也会隐藏实力？看联合行为如何识破伙伴的物理限制！
papers.abstract_zh: 在物理世界中运行的机器人将越来越多地需要与其他机器人协调，尤其是在物体过大或过重而单个机器人无法独自搬运的操作任务中。硬件退化或执行器故障引起的物理限制会制约机器人可靠执行的动作，但这些限制可能对其伙伴未知。我们研究一个辅助机器人能否通过观察一个机器人伙伴与另一个机器人协调来推断其物理约束，然后利用推断出的能力与同一伙伴在新任务上协调。这很困难，因为演示展示了受限机器人做了什么，而不是它本可以做什么。在物理耦合任务中，另一个机器人也可能补偿其限制，使得仅从受限机器人的行为难以识别这些限制。我们的关键见解是这些约束塑造了团队的联合行为，使得两个机器人的动作都提供了关于受限伙伴能力的信息。我们引入了观察、推断、协调，一个涵盖三种物理耦合操作设置的基准，以及一种利用观察到的联合行为对候选约束进行评分的推断方法。在所有三种设置中，我们的方法大幅提升了约束推断和零样本协调性能，接近拥有真实约束的预言机。

papers.title: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning
papers.title_zh: OmniSeek：面向多轮音视频推理的原生工具集成
papers.tldr_zh: OmniSeek让全模态大模型主动多轮调用工具，动态检索音视频证据，提升推理性能。
papers.cover_zh: 不再被动看全片！OmniSeek让模型自己决定何时看何时听
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出 OmniSeek，一个智能体框架，它将全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM）转变为具有原生工具使用能力的主动式多轮推理智能体。OmniSeek 不再通过单次前向传播被动处理整个音视频序列，而是将证据获取作为推理过程的一部分：它动态决定是看还是听，以及在哪个时间窗口内，从而在长上下文中跨不同模态检索稀疏但关键的证据。通过迭代的多轮协议，检索到的原始音频或视觉片段被追加回上下文以支持后续推理。为了冷启动这一能力，我们构建了一个数据引擎，合成了 OmniTraj-170K，这是一个包含交错音频和视觉证据的多跳思维链轨迹语料库。我们首先在这些轨迹上监督模型以灌输多轮工具使用行为，然后通过具有可验证奖励的两阶段强化学习进一步优化策略。此外，我们引入了一个音视频必要性目标，明确奖励那些推理依赖于两种模态的成功轨迹，抑制单模态捷径。在广泛基准上的大量实验表明，OmniSeek 学会了自适应跨模态证据寻求，并持续提升了音视频推理性能。
